Package io.webagent4j.crawler.api

Enum Class CrawlDecisionType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CrawlDecisionType>
io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlDecisionType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CrawlDecisionType>, Constable
public enum CrawlDecisionType extends Enum<CrawlDecisionType>
Every possible outcome of deciding whether a candidate URL enters the crawl frontier. Exactly one value is ALLOW; every other value is a distinct, diagnosable rejection reason - never a single opaque boolean.

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ALLOW
    The candidate is allowed to enter the frontier.
    REJECT_CANCELLED
    The crawl was cancelled before this candidate could be claimed.
    REJECT_DEPTH
    The candidate's depth would exceed CrawlRequest.maxDepth().
    REJECT_DOMAIN
    CrawlRequest.includeSubdomains() is set and the candidate's host is neither an allowed host nor one of its true subdomains (a lookalike such as evil-example.com for example.com is rejected, never accepted by a bare endsWith check).
    REJECT_DUPLICATE
    The candidate's normalized URL was already discovered earlier in this crawl.
    REJECT_HOST
    CrawlRequest.sameHostOnly() is set and the candidate's host does not match.
    REJECT_MAX_PAGES
    CrawlRequest.maxPages() unique fetch identities have already been claimed at the moment this link was discovered - a proactive, best-effort check: it can still miss a case where the limit is reached by a redirect hop consumed after this link was already enqueued, in which case the authoritative rejection instead surfaces later as a CrawlFailureType.CRAWL_LIMIT_REACHED CrawlFailure, never a silently dropped fetch.
    REJECT_SCHEME
    The candidate's scheme is not in CrawlRequest.allowedSchemes().
    REJECT_URL_FILTER
    The candidate's URL matched CrawlRequest.excludeUrlPatterns(), CrawlRequest.includeUrlPatterns() is non-empty and the candidate matched none of them, or (when at least one such pattern is configured) the candidate URL exceeded the maximum length evaluated against them - a resource bound, not a match outcome, but not worth a distinct type of its own since it is still fundamentally a URL-filter-stage rejection.

    • REJECT_CANCELLED

      public static final CrawlDecisionType REJECT_CANCELLED
      The crawl was cancelled before this candidate could be claimed. Cooperative cancellation is not yet implemented by every crawler engine in this project (see io.webagent4j.browsercrawler.CancellationToken for the one that does), but the reason itself is engine-neutral, so it lives here rather than being duplicated per engine.
